description: Look up the exact issuer name CDIAC uses for a California municipal bond issuer from a partial or informal name — "san diego" returns the dozens of distinct issuers containing it, from the city itself to its school, port and transit districts. Use this when a name is ambiguous before searching issuance.

name.description: Full or partial issuer name, e.g. "san diego".

name: ca_debt_resolve_issuer
